BLOCKRUN_WALLET_KEY.description: Optional existing wallet private key (hex, 0x-prefixed) to restore a funded BlockRun wallet. Leave blank to auto-generate a new EVM + Solana wallet on first boot and back it up from the deploy logs.

CLAWROUTER_PAYMENT_CHAIN.description: Chain used to settle pay-per-call model spend. Options: solana (default, cheapest fees) or base.

CLAWROUTER_SOLANA_RPC_URL.description: Solana RPC endpoint used for USDC balance checks. Swap in a private RPC if you hit public rate limits.

CLAWROUTER_DISABLED.description: Set to true to bypass smart routing and pass every request straight through to the upstream model.

CLAWROUTER_WORKER.description: Set to 1 to enable Worker Mode, which earns USDC by running BlockRun network health checks in the background.

CLAWROUTER_DEBUG_HEADERS.description: Controls x-clawrouter-* debug response headers exposing routing decisions. Set to off to suppress them.

BLOCKRUN_WEB_SEARCH.description: Registration mode for BlockRun's built-in web search tool. auto enables it when supported; off disables it.
